summary: Keep bundled SQLite in all native Rust Nix packages, preserving disabled allocation memory statistics and the 1 TiB mmap ceiling even when nixpkgs defaults to system libraries

replay.detail: Build environment correction only; no replay behavior changes.

schema.detail: No database schema or storage format changes.

rules.detail: No runtime rules or authority changes.

compatibility.detail: Restores the existing rusqlite bundled feature and .cargo/config.toml SQLite compilation flags; adds no system SQLite dependency.

downtime.detail: No migration or special deployment procedure is required.

manual.detail: Nix consumers receive the correction when updating their Fractal pin and may remove their equivalent downstream build override.

recovery.detail: Normal package rollback remains available; no persistent state changes.
